historical_reviews.deepseek: Directionally identifies the state-changing BMC update and need for image/console, but its command is unsafe and evidence incomplete.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps conditional classification while replacing transport, schema, authenticity, reset and recovery controls.
historical_reviews.history: V003 row 777 baseline and sequence 942 are a separate NVMe thermal sensor identity, excluded by code revision, row, variant and hash.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Critical firmware mutation requires explicit owner approval, vendor-exact workflow, immutable baseline, no automatic retry and engineer-owned verdict.

original_test_intent: Perform exactly one approved BMC firmware upgrade or downgrade via supported Redfish and verify authenticated image acceptance, terminal task success, one expected BMC reset, restored OOB access and intended firmware/host health.
original_method: Bind target and authenticated BMC image, preserve baseline, execute the vendor UpdateService under attended control, monitor task/reset/OOB/console, then verify BMC inventory and complete host/platform recovery.
manual_activity: The owner selects and authenticates the image, approves the maintenance window and recovery; an operator supervises power, console, task/reset/OOB recovery and stops on anomalies while automation performs the approved flow.
required_inputs: Selected direction and authenticated image digest/signature
Stable power, independent console and rollback/recovery
safety_requirements: Require explicit approval and stable power
Do not use curl -k, inline passwords or guessed endpoints/payloads
Protect baseline before any log handling
Monitor task, one reset and OOB loss/recovery
Never auto-retry or add an AC cycle
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, image, direction, signature and compatibility
Preserve baseline and start task/reset/OOB/console monitoring
Execute only the vendor-approved secret-safe Redfish update
Verify one reset, recovered BMC version, host/BIOS/OS/device health and logs
Do not select artifacts, recover autonomously or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve image, direction, window and rollback
Confirm stable power and independent console

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partially aligned in operation but unsafe and incomplete: it assumes transport/schema, weakens TLS and secret handling, and does not prove image compatibility, one reset, OOB recovery or host health.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a vendor-supported UpdateService client with trusted TLS, secret injection, exact schema and task monitoring only after all package, approval and recovery gates pass.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Upgrade/downgrade, Redfish, user-designated image intent, single-reset criterion and 15/15-minute values are retained; one direction is selected per execution.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute an authenticated baseline-transfer-task-reset-OOB-recovery-post-health state machine with evidence at each transition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Hardens transport/secrets and adds compatibility, exact reset/OOB oracle and whole-host recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; task completion, intended version, one reset, recovered management and unchanged host health are mandatory.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Failure can remove out-of-band recovery or brick the controller while the host remains in an uncertain state.

project_override_considerations: The project may choose upgrade or downgrade and the supported Redfish transfer mode, but must bind one authenticated compatible image, define one-reset/OOB semantics and preserve an independent recovery path.
expected_evidence: Approval, target identity, current/target versions and image signature/digest
Redacted request/response and task state transitions
Exactly one reset and OOB loss/recovery timeline
Post-flash BMC inventory plus host/BIOS/OS/device/health comparison
Recovery record if invoked and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The V004 row consistently defines BMC Redfish flashing. The V003 baseline sensor row is a different revision and physical identity and remains isolated.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Authenticated image, vendor schema, approval, stable power, console and rollback are finite normal prerequisites. Execution is prohibited until supplied but is not permanently impossible.

review_improvement: Retains DeepSeek's recognition of a state-changing BMC update but replaces its unsafe curl and incomplete evidence with an authenticated, recoverable task/reset/OOB state machine.
independent_technical_reasoning: The core operation is correctly identified, so the readiness class remains conditional; however, no generic multipart curl can safely substitute for the vendor contract. The critical blast radius requires owner-controlled artifacts and recovery plus attended execution.
